content.title: French defense tech startup Harmattan AI hits unicorn status with $200M Series B
content.summary: Ludovic Marin/Getty Images Europe has welcomed its first unicorn of the year as drone maker Harmattan AI raises a $200 million Series B. French aerospace group Dassault Aviation led the round, which pushes the Paris-based startup’s valuation to $1.4 billion. The two companies are also partnering to embed Harmattan AI’s technology into Dassault’s combat aviation systems.
